item.title: Are Main Battle Tanks Becoming Obsolete? Yes and No
item.description: The advent of advanced anti-tank weapons has pushed tanks further away from the front lines—but it would be a mistake to write them off altogether. The post Are Main Battle Tanks Becoming Obsolete? Yes and No appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: How Trump’s New National Security Strategy Takes on Hemispheric Defense
item.description: The precise wording of the NSS means little, as Trump will act however he pleases in any case. But the document is thought to accurately outline his thinking. The post How Trump’s New National Security Strategy Takes on Hemispheric Defense appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Why Switzerland Just Scaled Back Its Big F-35 Order
item.description: The scheduled acquisition of F-35 fighter jets has grown controversial in Switzerland following the Trump administration’s imposition of high tariffs. The post Why Switzerland Just Scaled Back Its Big F-35 Order appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Croatia Ditches Soviet-Era Armor for NATO’s Deadliest Leopard Tank
item.description: After seeing the Leopard 2’s success in the Ukraine war, Croatia has decided to procure the advanced tank platform. The post Croatia Ditches Soviet-Era Armor for NATO’s Deadliest Leopard Tank appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Ukraine Just Sank One of Russia’s Feared “Black Hole” Submarines
item.description: At the start of the Ukraine War, Russia had only three “Black Hole” submarines ready for combat in the Black Sea. That number has likely now decreased to one. The post Ukraine Just Sank One of Russia’s Feared “Black Hole” Submarines appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Europe’s Mighty Eurofighter May Soon Fly for Bangladesh
item.description: Bangladesh flies a combination of Soviet Union-era Mikoyan MiG-29s and Chinese-designed Chengdu F-7s, making the Eurofighter a real upgrade. The post Europe’s Mighty Eurofighter May Soon Fly for Bangladesh appeared first on The National Interest.
